name: Discover it Miles
notes: No annual fee. Discover has no foreign transaction fees as a network policy. First-year mile match bonus makes it especially compelling for new cardholders.

emergencyMedical.notes: No emergency medical or evacuation benefit.

travelBenefits.notes: Discover has charged zero foreign transaction fees as a network-wide policy. Acceptance abroad is limited — Discover has poor acceptance in many international markets outside US.

otherCredits.name: First-Year Mile Match
otherCredits.notes: Discover matches ALL miles earned in the first year for new cardholders. Effectively doubles your first-year earnings (e.g., 30,000 miles becomes 60,000 miles).

pointValue.transferPartners: No transfer partners. Miles redeem as statement credit toward travel purchases at 1 cent per mile.

travelPerks: No foreign transaction fees (Discover network policy)
First-year mile match (doubles all miles earned in year 1)
Miles redeem as statement credit for any travel purchase
Freeze it feature — instantly freeze/unfreeze card if lost
Free Social Security Number alerts and dark web monitoring
bestFor: No-fee travelers or beginners building credit who want simple flat-rate travel rewards — especially valuable in year one due to mile match
